subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI content clips under the collapsed sidebar in Safari on macOS

question: Should maintainers retire the open linked PR as obsolete after https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100296, or ask the contributor to rebase and prove a remaining desktop Safari fix?
rationale: The issue should not be auto-closed while a same-author closing PR remains open, but current main appears to have removed the tablet-width rail path shown in the screenshots.

options.title: Retire linked PR after proof
options.body: Recommended: verify the current-main collapsed navigation on Safari or equivalent geometry, close or supersede the conflicting linked PR, then close this issue with the merged PR evidence.

options.title: Rebase and prove linked PR
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/55861 and add current Safari/macOS proof if maintainers believe the desktop rail still needs the 96px change.

options.title: Keep both open
options.body: Leave both items open until the next release or a maintainer-run Safari repro confirms whether any released or desktop-only clipping remains.

recommendation.title: Retire linked PR after proof
recommendation.body: Recommended: verify the current-main collapsed navigation on Safari or equivalent geometry, close or supersede the conflicting linked PR, then close this issue with the merged PR evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged sidebar changes that likely removed the screenshot-matched rail path and is the clearest current owner for deciding whether the linked PR is obsolete.
